verdict.rationale: v0 documents a dedicated Platform API (v0.chats.create, v0.chats.init) with an official SDK on GitHub, enabling programmatic chat/project creation, code generation, and deployment integration, matching the story's requirements directly. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the API itself (community evidence covers the chat UI, not API usage) and fuller documentation of app/project management endpoints beyond chat creation.
